title: Comic Book Research Lab
text:
Welcome to the Comic Book Research Lab
where modern science meets comic books.






The Lab’s Mission


 Research
We conduct original and creative experiments and apply advanced statistical modeling to study comic book aging, effects of cleaning, and market factors.


 Collection Evaluation
We conduct transparent, honest, and respectful evaluations (not just valuations) of your collections, avoiding conflicts of interest.


 Education
We provide original perspectives on comic books and also seek to compile valuable educational materials from around the internet multiverse.


:::: {.appraisal-donate full-bleed}

Ethical Evaluation & Re-homing
Providing transparent, research-driven evaluations (of value and condition) and responsible re-homing that honor family connections and sentimental value, while maximizing both research insights and fair market value.
